title: Guidelines on Use of Vernacular Languages for Wayfinding Signs and Public Address Systems in Healthcare Institutions and MRT Stations
what_it_is: Guidelines on Use of Vernacular Languages for Wayfinding Signs and Public Address Systems in Healthcare Institutions and MRT Stations

sections.label: Help for elderly Singaporeans
sections.summary: Counter and service staff assist elderly Singaporeans with wayfinding, and MRT station names and travel advisories use the four official languages.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Infomation)
sentences.text: In general, counter and service staff are available in the healthcare institutions to assist elderly Singaporeans who need help with wayfinding.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Communications and Infomation)
sentences.text: In the case of our MRT stations, key information signages, such as station names, as well as public address announcements on important matters, such as travel advisories, are made using the four official languages.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: How they choose to rely on MTLs where it is relevant to meet the needs of their stakeholders is an assessment for the individual Ministry or agency to make.
